variableDeclarations.name: account_id
variableDeclarations.description: Account found by lookup_account. Empty until the caller is identified.

variableDeclarations.name: phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the account's phone number; safe to say aloud.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_provided_phone_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number the caller actually gave on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Login progress: none, code_sent, pass or locked. Only check_login_code or check_secret_pin sets pass.

variableDeclarations.name: login_code_sent
variableDeclarations.description: True once send_login_code has sent a code on the active account.

variableDeclarations.name: logged_in
variableDeclarations.description: True once check_login_code or check_secret_pin has verified the caller.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong login codes or PINs so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: login_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong login attempts so far on this call (alias for auth_failure_count).

variableDeclarations.name: pin_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong secret PINs so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: pin_attempts
variableDeclarations.description: Wrong secret PIN attempts so far on this call (alias for pin_failure_count).

variableDeclarations.name: payment_failure_count
variableDeclarations.description: Declined payment attempts so far on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the active payment card on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: declined_card_last4
variableDeclarations.description: Last 4 digits of the most recently declined card on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: payment_declined_once
variableDeclarations.description: True once a payment attempt has been declined on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: last_payment_method
variableDeclarations.description: Payment method used on the most recent successful payment attempt.

variableDeclarations.name: mock_error
variableDeclarations.description: Optional simulated backend error code for deterministic testing.

variableDeclarations.name: is_blocked
variableDeclarations.description: True when the caller phone number is on the blocked callers list.

variableDeclarations.name: language
variableDeclarations.description: Active BCP-47 language code for the call (en-US, fr-CA, es-US). Empty until detected or set.

variableDeclarations.name: preferred_language
variableDeclarations.description: Preferred language code on the caller's profile or detected from utterances.

variableDeclarations.name: last_user_utterance
variableDeclarations.description: Most recent user utterance text, when available.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_reason
variableDeclarations.description: Reason recorded when handing the caller over to a person.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_status
variableDeclarations.description: Handoff status: completed_via_specialist_queue when handover_to_person has run.

variableDeclarations.name: handover_complete
variableDeclarations.description: True once handover_to_person has run on this call.

variableDeclarations.name: handoff_message
variableDeclarations.description: Exact localized handover sentence to speak before ending the session.

variableDeclarations.name: last_tracking_id
variableDeclarations.description: Most recent reference number returned by a tool.

variableDeclarations.name: request_summary
variableDeclarations.description: Summary of the most recent submitted request.
